notes.title: Update 2.6
notes.content:
- All weapons are now automatic, so triggers can be hold
- New BGM Music and adjustable Music Volume
- Fix Trucks not disappearing upon death
- Fix no Enemy appearing in Wave Mode sometimes
- Made Train faster when going down or at the end of the wave levels
- Improved Bullet Time Detection
- Improved Bullet Size for Visibility
- Increased Screen Resolution for PS5
- Fixed Customization not staying on Weapon
- Added more Customizations
- Added Turning for Seated Gameplay
- Added Turning Options
- Added Hit Shots Display to Pause Menu
- Added a Restart Level Button at the end of a Level
- Fixed issues with overlapping turrets or rockets in wave mode

notes.title: Update 2.5
notes.content:
- Fixed an issue with hidden Achievements
- Fixed Counting of Hit and Total Shots
- Fixed an issue where points and ammo is lost when exiting or restarting a level in the story

notes.title: Update 2.4
notes.content: Improved Loading and Saving of SaveGames.

notes.title: Update 2.3
notes.content: Added Display in Main Menu for shot enemies.

notes.title: Update 2.2
notes.content:
- Added Vignette and Vignette FOV Option
- Added new Rhine Games Logo
- Comfort Warning is now always facing the player
- Reduced MSAA for additional performance gains
- Points Text are now appearing less, but add up together
- Opening the pause menu now requires a tap
- MP5 Cooldown has been reduced
- Leaderboard size has been reduced to avoid the Scrollbar
- Both Weapons share now the same Ammo
- Improved Performance in Industry Level
- Improved Performance for Explosions
- Fixed Rating at the End of a Level not always working
- Fixed Wave Levels not unlocking
- Reduced Bullet Recovery Time, now gameplay should be much faster
- Fix Speed Effect not visible when not looking at it

notes.title: Update 2.1 - Neon Valley Revenge & Reduced Price
notes.content:
Starting with the Steam VR Fest, Train Chase will be permanently reduced to 6.99$ aswell as 50% reduced during the Event. In addition, a lot of changes have been introduced into the game:

New
- Added Weapon Menu at the start of a story level
- Added new Blink Effect for Enemies
- Added new level based on the game Neon Valley Revenge
- Added Neon Weapon Skin
- Added Ammo Icon to Weapon Menu
- Quest 3 Controller Images
- Quest 3 now has improved graphics
- Quest 3 now has improved haptics

Improvements
- Terrain should not change based on distance anymore
- Health of all enemies has been adjusted
- Enemy Hiteffect is now based on the remaining health
- Increased offset for Non-VR Dodging
- Added additional buttons to interact with the menu
- Fixed some Lighting issues on Turret and Train Wagons
- Grenade Launcher now deals more damage

New Issues
- Save Games System changed, resulting in a loss of the saves. Join the Discord Server and I'll help you

notes.title: Massive Update for Train Chase now live!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=JhubyWri4yk;full][/previewyoutube]

A massive Update for Train Chase is now live!

The Update features the new Story Mode. Travel through a forest, get chased in a canyon, or head downward from the top of a mountain!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40053433/7ea07aa5acb6f25b4240fbb12071ce66e48bf10d.png[/img]

All this while facing challenging enemies, like the drones or the turrets, which appear on the way and try to stop you.

Dodge their bullets during the bullet time to avoid getting shot and having to restart.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40053433/1534f025a13301807ca6dac92551459af0ae246a.png[/img]

If you make it to the end of a level, a boss will appear. Recognize the pattern and defeat the boss to end the level and earn points.

At the end of the story, you'll be added to the leaderboard for the world to see.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40053433/89a3c39ce5edd4a09b921472bd2e14faf2c2be76.png[/img]

Once you are done, or if you only want a quick round, jump into the wave levels and defeat waves of enemies to get a high rank on the leaderboard of each level.

I'm excited to hear your opinions on the new update, so jump on the Discord server and get informed if someone has beat your high score!

notes.title: New Update will release next week!
notes.content:
Quite some time passed since the last news, so today I am happy to share with you that a big free update will come out next week!

Watch the video to get a first impression:

[previewyoutube=JhubyWri4yk;full][/previewyoutube]

The new update is massive. The first thing you will notice is the new art style. As the game will also release on standalone headsets, I updated the art style to be performant yet visually appealing.

Here on Steam, you'll have additional graphics features, like shadows, more foliage and better lighting.

Another update is the new Story Mode! Face challenging and different-looking levels with boss fights at the end!

Once you've done it, jump into casual Wave Levels.

Both, the Story and the Wave Levels come with a Leaderboard, so you can try becoming the Nr. 1 again!

Also, the gameplay has been improved, making the dodge mechanic now more rewarding, the pickup mechanic easier to use and shooting more fun.

I'm excited to hear your opinions on this new update.

The new update will come out on the 21st of July, 2023.

notes.title: New Updates coming soon
notes.content:
Hey,

Sorry for keeping updates for this game low over the last months.

I have been concentrated on my other two games, one of which will go in Early Access at the 31st of March.

But I'll promise that starting May, there will be updates coming to Train Chase. Here is a list of planned things I want to improve:


- New UI with better Graphics
- Graphics Improvements
- New Environments
- Improved Weapon Handling
- More Weapons
- Weapon Skins
- Liv Support
- New Enemies
- Oculus Support

The game was my first solo game, so it was the best I could do at the time. While developing my other games, my skillset has improved and I want to show this with the new updates which you'll see in the game.

Those updates will be free and the price will not change. So if you consider buying it, you can do so at any time.

If you want to know more or talk with me, [url=https://discord.com/invite/uhVZhaRXkN]join my Discord Server[/url]!

notes.title: BHaptics
notes.content:
Train Chase now supports bHaptics! Whether you play in VR or not in VR and you have bHaptics Hardware connected, you'll receive feedback based on the actions in the game.

Those vastly expand on the immersion of the game! I hope you'll enjoy it.
